messages:
evan.s: Heads-up — Acme wants a completed SIG/CAIQ + short security writeup for procurement. Deadline is next Fri EOD. They also asked about KMS key ownership and EU data residency. Can security pick this up?
sec_team_bot: New intake created: INT-ACME-2026-53 — assigned to security triage queue. SLA target: 3 business days. :spiral_calendar: 
jamie: @evan.s thanks. Can you attach the questionnaire they uploaded and confirm which environment will the POC use (prod-like or sandbox)? Also any customer-specific clauses in the SOW? :eyes:
alex.k: quick note — if they want KMS customer-managed keys, we need the KMS provider + whether they require HSM-backed keys. That affects our Private deployment checklist.
evan.s: Uploaded the CAIQ PDF and the Excel SIG. POC will run in dedicated sandbox in us-west for now. SOW has DPA + standard security addendum, no extra clauses yet. Link: https://files.redwood/example/acme/sig-uploads
priya: Sales asks — can security do an expedited review? Acme wants vendor approval by Tuesday to meet renewal window. They also have a pricing question tied to whether data can stay in EU. If data residency is required, price differs.
jamie: Noted. We'll mark as high-priority. Initial triage: 1) Data residency — we can route to EU-hosted dedicated or Private but need network details. 2) KMS — we support cloud-managed CMKs and customer-managed keys via KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). HSM/KMS integration needs timeline. 3) SOC2/Security evidence — provide SOC2 report and pen test summary.
alex.k: For the CAIQ rows about network segmentation + tenant isolation, here's the snippet I usually share:
```
- Deployment model: Dedicated GPU pool
- Network: VPC peering + security groups, no public data plane access
- Keys: Customer-managed CMK via AWS KMS (optional)
- Logs: Audit logs exported to customer's Cloud Logging\/SIEM
```
maria_s: I can own POC infra provisioning this week. @alex.k can you list the minimal config I should create in the sandbox to satisfy their 'prod-like' requirement?
alex.k: Minimal config: 1 x ded pool (4xA10G), private subnets, KMS role, S3 bucket with SSE-KMS, VPC endpoints for monitoring. I'll paste the IAM policy snippet in a sec.
sam: Legal chiming in — if they want CMKs we need to check DPA + contract for key escrow or cross-account policies. Also data residency requirement might trigger an addendum. Priya, please flag if ACME is a public sector customer.
priya: ACME is commercial, but they have EU-based customers and require EU data at rest for EU-subset of tenants.
jamie: Action plan: 1) Security triage will answer CAIQ top 20 risk items by EOD tomorrow. 2) Provide SOC2/pentest artifacts to Acme security portal. 3) Offer EU-hosted dedicated as option and note pricing delta. 4) Owner for POC infra: maria_s. 5) Owner for KMS design: alex.k.
evans.s: Thanks all. Any blockers on getting SOC2? We have the last report ready. Where should I upload?
jamie: Upload to the secure intake link: https://sec.redwood/upload (share-only link) and put INT-ACME-2026-53 in the filename.
priya: Noted. Also customer asked if we support encryption-at-rest with customer keys for embeddings specifically. Is that a separate capability?
alex.k: It's the same; embeddings stored in S3/DB can be SSE-KMS with customer CMK. Need to confirm with infra about tokenization scope.
jamie: I'm going to triage the SIG now. Expect an initial answer to the 10 highest-risk CAIQ questions within 24 hours. Will post status updates here. :thumbsup:
maria_s: Provisioning started — I'll ping when endpoints are ready.
sec_team_bot: INT-ACME-2026-53 status updated: triage_in_progress -> in_progress by jamie at 1715001200
evan.s: Appreciate the speed. If we can get a short security summary (1 pager) and the CAIQ answers by Tues morning, we can keep the deal on track.
sam: I'll review contract implications tomorrow AM.
jamie: Update at 1715002400 — CAIQ top 10 answered and uploaded to intake portal. Still validating KMS/HSM items with alex.k.
alex.k: Uploaded IAM policy and sample KMS config:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"}
  ]
}
```
priya: Shared to customer portal. ACME responded: wanted confirmation that keys are customer-owned — they said :raised_hands: if we can do that they will greenlight POC.
jamie: Good. Next steps: finalize KMS cross-account doc and SOC2 redactions. If any elevated risk items remain, propose mitigations and risk-acceptance owner.
maria_s: POC endpoints up, gave Acme service account with access to sandbox.
evans.s: Customer confirmed they can proceed with POC, pending final KMS doc. Thanks everyone. :tada:
sec_team_bot: INT-ACME-2026-53 status updated: in_progress -> resolved_by_jamie at 1715003600
jamie: Closing thread — I flagged the KMS pattern in our knowledge base and added a note about EU pricing delta. If they escalate, reopen INT-ACME-2026-53.
sam: Filing contract addendum request.
priya: Great work all.
